core.title: Evidence-Licensed Memory
core.status: VerdiWM stores actions, receipts, model context, validity gates, and claim boundaries so repairs are reused only when evidence licenses transfer.
core.model: Operational and epistemic control planes over world-model repair campaigns
core.dataset: Run receipts, paired probes, replay artifacts, metrics, and verifier outputs
core.intervention: Claim-licensed repair memory and certified transfer
core.evidence: Action -> receipt -> settlement vector -> claim-frontier update

docs.title: VerdiWM Research Memory Graph
docs.summary: Defines each node as a bounded repair episode with time, model, dataset, intervention, gate status, and claim scope.
points: Indexes model changes by claim scope rather than by loose chat history.
Connects experiment artifacts to reusable repair decisions.
Keeps the page-level visualization aligned with the evidence contract.

docs.title: Evidence Claim Gate Skill
docs.summary: Defines when a VerdiWM result is allowed to become a reusable repair claim.
points: Separates environment success from video or VLM audit evidence.
Requires action requests, execution receipts, and verification artifacts.
Updates the claim frontier only when evidence is sufficient.

ctrlworld-lamo.title: Ctrl-World LaMo Repair
ctrlworld-lamo.status: A physical-consistency diagnosis found copy-current-frame behavior and weak action-driven latent transition.
ctrlworld-lamo.intervention: LaMo latent motion prior, drift loss, frozen SVD/VAE parts, hierarchical LR
ctrlworld-lamo.evidence: WorldArena metrics, PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/FID, qualitative replay, and validity-gate annotations

docs.title: Ctrl-World + LaMo Fusion Training Skill
docs.summary: A concrete architecture and training recipe for adding latent motion priors to Ctrl-World.
points: Adds a motion-prior branch and drift readout in latent space.
Keeps stable SVD/VAE components frozen while training action-sensitive layers.
Uses targeted ablations to test whether motion is action-conditioned.

docs.title: Evidence Claim Gate Skill
docs.summary: Records how the LaMo intervention should be promoted only after evidence clears the claim gate.
points: Do not treat a lower scalar loss as sufficient mechanism evidence.
Require replay or latent-separation checks before widening the claim.
Keep the intervention scoped to the Ctrl-World physical-consistency failure mode.

dino-rep.title: Cosmos-Predict2 REP Repair
dino-rep.status: REP uses representation signals to improve structure, geometry, and motion while exposing an appearance-consistency boundary.
dino-rep.dataset: BridgeData replay set with WorldArena-style metrics
dino-rep.evidence: Semantic alignment, depth, flow, motion smoothness, qualitative replay, and gate-limited claim scope

docs.title: DINO-REP Cosmos-Predict2 Repair Skill
docs.summary: Encodes the REP intervention and the next-patch rule for appearance-consistency boundaries.
points: Treats depth and motion gains separately from appearance consistency.
Uses metric deltas to route the next patch rather than stopping at a score.
Targets REP injection position and appearance retention when needed.

robocoin.title: RoboCOIN Transfer
robocoin.status: The agent selected a compatible action-conditioned video-to-world setup from dataset structure, embodiment, viewpoint, and action interface.
robocoin.intervention: Dataset adapter, embodiment-aware base-model selection, no-action control replay
robocoin.evidence: Green-folder, red-folder, and three-view consistency qualitative comparisons

docs.title: RoboCOIN Transfer Adapter Skill
docs.summary: Documents how the transfer node maps dataset and robot metadata into a model adaptation decision.
points: Uses embodiment and camera metadata before choosing the base model.
Keeps no-action prediction as an overfitting control.
Scopes the claim to selected RoboCOIN tasks and replay evidence.

robolab-rl.title: Action-Quality Rollouts
robolab-rl.status: The action-quality node checks whether long-horizon world-model repair improves policy rollouts under environment-grounded success criteria.
robolab-rl.intervention: Reward-bounded RL with safety and invalid-action penalties
robolab-rl.evidence: Block-stack original-vs-RL paired rollouts and reward contract

docs.title: RoboLab120 Policy-RL Reward Skill
docs.summary: Defines the RL reward and its constraints so progress cannot fake terminal success.
points: Terminal success comes from RoboLab, not VLM scoring.
Failed trajectories are capped below successful trajectories.
Video and VLM checks remain audit-only.

franka-real.title: FRANKA Real-Robot Trials
franka-real.status: The real-robot node compares original Cosmos3 and repaired Cosmos3 on stack, fold, and occluded drawer manipulation.
franka-real.intervention: Real-robot transfer with improved grasping, path planning, and occlusion handling
franka-real.evidence: 4x H.264 comparison videos for stack, tablecloth, and drawer tasks

docs.title: FRANKA Real-Robot Transfer Skill
docs.summary: Summarizes the task set, observed original failures, and repaired Cosmos3 behavior.
points: Tracks stack, fold, and drawer tasks under the same real-robot section.
Uses accelerated public videos for presentation, not for changing task labels.
Links each qualitative claim to a visible comparison artifact.

claim-gate.title: Frozen Verifier
claim-gate.status: The verifier node prevents the memory graph from turning every observation into a broad claim.
claim-gate.dataset: Execution receipts, metrics, replays, and environment outcomes
claim-gate.evidence: Pass/fail gates and bounded claim scopes

docs.title: Evidence Claim Gate Skill
docs.summary: Defines the gate logic for promoting a result into a reusable memory.
points: Record the proposed intervention and execution receipt.
Verify success with the authority appropriate for the claim.
Keep video/VLM audit evidence separate from environment success.

docs.title: VerdiWM Research Memory Graph
docs.summary: Explains how the graph indexes evidence by model, dataset, intervention, and claim scope.
points: Prevents score-only memory from hiding mechanism failures.
Makes prior patches inspectable before selecting the next action.
Connects knowledge nodes to concrete skill documents.
